title: Director of Estimating - Data Center Fit-Out Cost Strategy (Nashville, TN)
description:
The Global Program Controls organization provides governance, reporting, controls processes, cost management support, and portfolio visibility to help Oracle Cloud Infrastructure deliver global data center programs with greater consistency, transparency, and execution discipline.

Oracle is seeking a Director of Estimating to build and lead an owner-side cost-intelligence function for data-center tenant fit-out and technology infrastructure.

This is not a contractor bidding or business-development role. The Director will establish independent, should-cost estimates and market benchmarks that allow us to assess, challenge, and negotiate pricing submitted by co-location providers and low-voltage contractors. The role will also partner closely with Engineering to ensure our design standards deliver the required performance without creating unnecessary cost.

The right candidate combines deep experience in low-voltage and technology- infrastructure estimating with strong commercial judgment, data-center awareness, and a practical vision for automating estimating through AI.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build an owner-side estimating capability that establishes independent should-cost estimates for our recurring data-center tenant fit-out build types.
* Develop benchmark pricing, unit-cost libraries, labor assumptions, productivity factors, and market intelligence for low-voltage, technology-infrastructure , power, and pathway scopes.
* Review co-location provider fit-out proposals and low-voltage contractor pricing; identify gaps, unsupported allowances, scope overlap, risk premiums, and opportunities to negotiate.
* Provide leadership with clear, defensible cost positions before and during commercial negotiations.
* Create repeatable, bid-ready assumptions and scope packages for each build type, allowing co-location providers to price against a common baseline.

description:

----------------

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Director of Business Intelligence and AI Analytics (Nashville, TN)
description:
The Global Program Controls organization provides governance, reporting, controls processes, cost management support, and portfolio visibility to help Oracle Cloud Infrastructure deliver global data center programs with greater consistency, transparency, and execution discipline.

We are seeking a hands-on technical leader to build and deploy the dashboards, reports, and AI-enabled analytics that help senior leadership understand operational performance, identify risks, and make informed decisions.

We have an established database foundation supported by data entry and governance processes. This role will build on that foundation by turning trusted data into reliable reporting products that people use in their daily work. The position will integrate information from Oracle Primavera Cloud (OPC), our scheduling platform, Oracle Primavera Unifier, and Oracle APEX applications and their underlying data sources.

The successful candidate will personally write queries, develop reporting models, build dashboards, connect systems, and deploy solutions into production. They will also establish reporting priorities and technical standards, working closely with business leaders, system owners, and technical teams. The role carries substantial technical ownership and can operate as a senior individual contributor leading cross-functional delivery.

Strong technical execution must be paired with analytical judgment and clear communication. This person should be able to investigate a discrepancy in the underlying data, explain its business significance, and deliver an accurate, concise view for executives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dashboard and Reporting Development**

* Design, build, and deploy executive and operational dashboards that provide consistent views of schedules, milestones, delivery progress, dependencies, and emerging risks.
* Translate business questions into defined metrics, data requirements, reporting logic, and intuitive visualizations with useful filters
